invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Author and subject identities remain distinct and exact. [2] Each recommendation has explicit identity.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative feedback is explicit evidence and may enter review workflow.
semantics.ownership_rule: Recommendations and derived trust belong to MeritCore.
semantics.portfolio_rule: PortfolioCore may reference/display recommendations but does not own or calculate them.
semantics.project_rule: Project/context ref is explicit where applicable.
semantics.provenance_rule: Recommendation retains creation/source provenance and cannot be silently rewritten.
semantics.recommendation_rule: Recommendation has explicit author identity, subject identity and context/Project refs where applicable.
semantics.self_rule: Self-recommendation cannot satisfy external recommendation thresholds unless an explicit policy permits a distinct semantics.
semantics.trust_rule: Trust is derived according to explicit MeritCore rules/evidence rather than free-form profile claims.
